Client project · E-commerce

WesternStains

Gathered client requirements and structured a Shopify store around how customers choose and purchase wood oils.

My role
Client discovery and Shopify delivery
Period
2024
Project stage
Archived storefront

Client need

The client needed a storefront that could explain and sell wood oils. Customers needed enough information to select a suitable product for the surface and application.

Requirements and information architecture

I gathered client requirements and organized collections, product pages and buying guides around the customer’s comparison process.

Delivery

I built the Shopify storefront so customers could browse the product range, consult buying guidance and purchase on the same site.

Merchandising requirements

I structured collections to support selection by surface and application, then used product pages and buying guidance to connect a customer’s intended use to suitable products. The storefront brought comparison and purchase into the same path.
